RON

The display typeface for developers who ship taste.

An all-caps grotesque engineered for terminals, editors, launch pages and loud brand systems — drawn from a hand-cut bitmap alphabet, traced to solid vectors, and released free under the SIL Open Font License.

FIVE SKINS, ONE SKELETON

Every RON theme shares the same underlying geometry — the same chamfered corners, the same aggressive proportions — re-rendered for a different job.

RON BLACK FLAGSHIP

RON 0123
The original. Heavy, chamfered, unapologetic. Headlines that hit like a merge conflict with a fixed bug.

RON MONO TERMINAL

RON 0123
Ron is monospaced here — same advances for every glyph, centered. Built for code panels, status bars and CLI banners.

RON DOT BRAILLE

RON 0123
A dot-matrix halftone of the same alphabet. Loading screens, sprint boards and Awwwards juries' guilty pleasures.

RON SCAN CRT

RON 0123
Horizontal scanlines clipped to the RON skeleton. For retro-computing interfaces and haunted toggle switches.

RON OUTLINE HOLLOW

RON 0123
The ring only, stroked in RON Black's silhouette. Watermarks, ghost layers and layered titles with depth.

IN THE WILD

RON ships as plain OpenType files — drop them into any editor, terminal, site or splash screen.

// ron, committed to your terminal
git commit -m "feat: RON everywhere"
// install the whole family
git clone ron-type   // 5 themes, one DNA
$ npm i ron-type
$ ron dot build
$ localhost:3000

THE ALPHABET

A–Z, 0–9, and the punctuation a developer actually touches. Caps-only by design; lowercase maps to caps.
